caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical glass jar with a wide body and a broad mouth, topped with a flat, circular lid. The jar is rendered in transparent, light gray, and white tones to represent its glass material, with soft shading indicating reflections and the curved surfaces. The base of the jar has a textured, wavy pattern that is visible through the glass, suggesting a slightly raised or molded design. The lid is solid and opaque, colored in a reddish-brown hue with varied darker and lighter areas to imply texture and shadow. The jar and lid are centered on a plain, light beige background, and there are small, faint pencil markings and notes under the jar, including a date and some line work in the bottom left corner.
title: Shaker Sugar Jar
